question: Does replacing the sink with frames of the new scene (reanchor) let the prompt change take effect without the drift seen with decay?
hypotheses: notes/research/cards/H03. Recache без дообучения достаточно для перехода.md
notes/research/cards/H04. Текущий decay даёт приемлемую смену сцены.md
derived_from: outputs/sw-decay.json (experiment 2026-10-17/03), the same three prompts and seed
mode: as in training of Self-Forcing: 480x832, shift 5.0, BF16 weights and KV, context 21 frames, context noise 0
prompts: A stunning mid-afternoon landscape photograph with a low camera angle, showcasing several giant wooly mammoths treading through a snowy meadow. Their long, wooly fur gently billows in the brisk wind as they move, creating a sense of natural movement. Snow-covered trees and dramatic snow-capped mountains loom in the distance, adding to the majestic setting. Wispy clouds and a high sun cast a warm glow over the scene, enhancing the serene and awe-inspiring atmosphere. The depth of field brings out the detailed textures of the mammoths and the snowy environment, capturing every nuance of these prehistoric giants in breathtaking clarity.
The same herd of woolly mammoths walks into a dense pine forest as heavy snow begins to fall, soft grey light, the camera follows them at a low angle, cinematic.
The woolly mammoths reach a frozen lake at sunset, warm orange light glows on the ice and on their fur, wide cinematic shot.

swap.role: baseline: old sink and memory kept

reanchor.role: sink replaced by the first 10 frames of the new scene, then recache

blend_reanchor.role: text blended over 4 chunks, sink replaced

decay_reanchor.role: old memory fades for 4 chunks; then reanchor's recache resets the caches (and the decay state) from new-scene frames only

not_included: new empty cache (H02): no such switch in causal.SWITCHES yet
decay without fading the sink: needs a change in KVCache.forget
observe: does the scene follow each new prompt, and how many seconds after the switch
does the image float or drift after the switch (colour, sharpness, camera zoom onto one animal)
is the herd kept across the switch
limitations: one seed, one prompt sequence: observations, not a test
reanchor recaches 18 frames once the new scene has 12 frames: a pause of several seconds in Live
the 2026-10-17 run used sink 9 and 99 latent frames; compare with the swap of this run, not with it
